node_definition.done_when: A fresh dispatch of a two-figure node on a lane that declares image input and whose dialect has no attach flag writes a <run_dir>/prompt.txt that names both PNG paths and the Read instruction, held by a test in tests/test_dispatch_attaches_the_figures.py that reads that file, not plan.stdin_text. A lane change of such a run onto that lane writes its lane-change prompt file (the lane-change-N-prompt.txt for attempt N) naming each path exactly once and carrying the restated fence, held by tests/test_crew_lane_change.py. A fresh dispatch on the cli launch path and a lane change write the prompt file from plan.stdin_text once the plan is built, which carries the composed prompt on every dialect since every dialect inherits stdin_prompt; an in-harness dispatch composes no plan and still writes its prompt.txt from the uncomposed prompt without raising; change_lane restates the fence before composing, not at the file write. The same two-figure node dispatched on codex writes a prompt.txt that carries the brief and no figure listing, its paths riding -i; a lane change of the two-figure clive run onto codex writes a lane-change prompt file carrying the brief and the restated fence and no figure listing; a figureless dispatch writes a prompt.txt carrying the brief and no figure listing. launch_plan in reckon/_backends.py strips any figure listing the prompt it is handed already carries, on every lane and before the branch that decides whether the lane is named its figures, so a prompt that already carries a listing composes to exactly one listing naming the current figures on a named lane and to none on codex. For lanes declaring [text, image], [text], [], nothing, [IMAGE], [' image '] and the string 'text,image', declares_image_input in reckon/_backends.py and declared_input_modalities in reckon/flight.py agree on whether the lane admits an image, the last three admitting one, because declares_image_input reads the declaration through a function in reckon/flight.py that strips and case-folds each entry and reads a string as a comma-separated list; held by tests/test_a_local_worker_is_named_its_images.py. The comment above IMAGE_MODALITY in reckon/_backends.py names only readers that exist. The test files build their flight, stores and run directories in a temporary directory and read nothing outside it. ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on changed Python files against base. Every log is written under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in EXIT=. The coordinator runs the importer population of reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py, reckon/_backends.py and reckon/flight.py at merge; do not run a base arm
